description: Converts an audio or video file to MP3. Input: one file with a public HTTPS download_url. Optional outputFormat (for example mp3, wav, m4a) and bitrateKbps where the tool supports them. Returns download links for the result, which expire after 1 hour. The server downloads the file from download_url, keeps it in ihateaudio's Cloudflare R2 storage while the job runs, and processes it with the ihateaudio.com tool page in a headless browser on Cloudflare. The input is deleted when the job ends.

bitrateKbps.description: Bitrate for lossy formats, in kbps.

download_url.description: Public HTTPS link to the audio or video file. The server downloads it from here.

file_id.description: Set by ChatGPT for files shared in the chat. Other clients leave it out.

outputFormat.description: Output format, for example mp3, wav, m4a, ogg or flac.

name: mp3_converter
title: MP3 Converter
